Extract exposures matched to each record's survey year

Source: R/exposure.R
svy_extract_by_year.Rd

For a multi-year raster stack (one layer per year), extracts the layer that matches each record's interview year, optionally lagged and averaged over several years. Only the layers that are needed are read.

Usage

svy_extract_by_year(
  buffers,
  raster,
  date_col = "date",
  lag_years = 0,
  window_years = 1,
  layer_years = NULL,
  fun = "mean",
  id_col = "id",
  name = "exposure",
  max_cells_in_memory = 3e+07
)

Arguments

buffers

An sf polygon object, usually from svy_buffers().

raster

A SpatRaster, a file path, or a GDAL virtual path such as "/vsicurl/https://.../pm25_2019.tif" for Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs.

date_col

Name of the Date column used for matching.

lag_years

Years to lag the exposure. 1 uses the year before interview.

window_years

Number of consecutive years to average, ending at the lagged year. 3 with lag_years = 0 averages the interview year and the two years before it. Records with any missing year get NA.

layer_years

Integer vector giving the year of each raster layer. If NULL, years are taken from terra::time() or, failing that, from four-digit years in the layer names (e.g. "pm25_2016").

fun

Summary function name passed to exact_extract(), e.g. "mean", "median", "max", "sum".

id_col

Identifier column in buffers to carry into the output.

name

Name of the output exposure column.

max_cells_in_memory

Upper limit on raster cells held in memory. Lower it on machines with little RAM.

Value

A data frame with id_col, exposure_year (the last year of the window) and the exposure column.
